overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board did not deliberate outside a properly noticed meeting to schedule the hearing, and it declined to review the non-OML bylaw notice claim.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated outside a properly noticed meeting to schedule a January 23, 2013 public hearing on proposed taxi regulation amendments.
allegations.key_passage: In the absence of any evidence to the contrary, we credit the Board's account of the facts and find that the Board did not deliberate and therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the hearing notice violated the Town of Nantucket Bylaws by not giving 21 days' notice; this is not an Open Meeting Law claim.
allegations.key_passage: As Mr. Pearson himself noted, he does not allege a violation of the Open Meeting Law.  We therefore decline to investigate this allegation.
